trickyParts: Oh My Pi records a bash call as the tool_call hook returns it, so any input rewrite is what the agent reads back. A note explaining the rewrite did not move the agents (4 of 6 still disbelieved it); keeping the flag visible in the command they read did (0 of 6).
The comment goes on the first line only, so a quoted here-document's body is never touched; an override whose raw text spans lines is not put back.
deviations: The device path cannot keep the field (the device validates its JSON), so its acknowledgement says AskGate removed it. No Legion pod mounts a dispatch device, so that path is unit-covered only.
